name: Sage
label: Sage — Sage Business Cloud Accounting API v3.1
description: Official Sage Business Cloud Accounting API v3.1 at https://api.accounting.sage.com/v3.1. Docs: https://developer.sage.com/accounting/. Bodies nest under contact / sales_invoice / contact_payment. X-Business header from config business_id. Access token minted outside this node (~5 min). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Sage. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: contact_create | invoice_create | invoice_get | payment_create. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Sales invoice GUID for invoice_get path /sales_invoices/{id}.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Contact display name. Nested as contact.name on contact_create. Required. Example: Acme Ltd.

schema.label: contact_type_ids
schema.description: Sage contact type GUIDs. Nested as contact.contact_type_ids on contact_create. Required. Customer CUSTOMER, supplier VENDOR. Example: ["CUSTOMER"].

schema.label: contact_id
schema.description: Sage contact GUID. Required on invoice_create (sales_invoice.contact_id) and payment_create (contact_payment.contact_id).

schema.label: invoice_lines
schema.description: Official invoice line objects for invoice_create (sales_invoice.invoice_lines). Each line: description, ledger_account_id, quantity, unit_price, tax_rate_id. Required.

schema.label: transaction_type_id
schema.description: Payment type GUID or key for payment_create (contact_payment.transaction_type_id). CUSTOMER_RECEIPT | VENDOR_PAYMENT. Required.

schema.label: total_amount
schema.description: Payment total. Nested as contact_payment.total_amount on payment_create. Required. Example: 100.00.

schema.label: reference
schema.description: Your reference. contact_create → contact.reference; invoice_create → sales_invoice.reference; payment_create → contact_payment.reference.

schema.label: tax_number
schema.description: VAT/tax number. Nested as contact.tax_number on contact_create. Example: GB123456789.

schema.label: notes
schema.description: Free-text notes. contact_create → contact.notes; invoice_create → sales_invoice.notes.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Contact email. Nested as contact.email on contact_create. Example: billing@example.com.

schema.label: telephone
schema.description: Contact phone. Nested as contact.telephone on contact_create.

schema.label: main_address
schema.description: Official address object for contact_create (contact.main_address): address_line_1, city, postal_code, country_id.

schema.label: date
schema.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Required on invoice_create (sales_invoice.date) and payment_create (contact_payment.date). Example: 2026-10-31.

schema.label: bank_account_id
schema.description: Sage bank account GUID. Required on payment_create (contact_payment.bank_account_id).

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: contact_create | invoice_create | invoice_get | payment_create. Default contact_create. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Sage credential (bearer Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Business Id
configurationParameters.description: Sage Business Cloud Accounting X-Business header. Required for multi-business tokens. Sent on every request.
